operationalization.H: identity of the species that previously modified the extracellular environment
operationalization.m: filtered extracellular supernatant/environmental modification; washing/removal and supernatant rescue provide intervention relevance
operationalization.tau: observed community horizons days 5, 10 and 12; not intrinsic tau_m
operationalization.P_acc: retrospective species-retention support at day 12 across eight supernatant challenges relative to no-supernatant controls
